```{r cars}
suppressWarnings(df_clima_2025 <- read_excel("G:/Unidades compartidas/Compartido Proyecciones/11.- Variables Meteorológicas/2026/Resumen de Variables Meteorológicas/Sem 11/Variables Meteorológicas F7_09-03-2026.xlsx", sheet = "BD ", skip = 2, col_names = TRUE, col_types = c(rep("guess", 6), rep("numeric", 16),rep("skip",8))))

suppressWarnings(df_clima_2026 <- read_excel("G:/Unidades compartidas/Compartido Proyecciones/11.- Variables Meteorológicas/2026/5.- Actualización Diaria/F-RI.123 Variables Estación Metereológica F7 - 2026.xls", sheet = "Consolidado", col_names = TRUE, col_types = c("date", "date", rep("numeric",6), "text", "text", "numeric", "numeric", "text", rep("numeric",28))))
```

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
df_weather_2025 <- df_clima_2025 %>% 
  mutate(DateTime = as.POSIXct(paste(Fecha, format(Hora, "%H:%M:%S")), format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")) %>% 
  filter(Año != 2026) %>% 
  select(-Año, -Abreviatura, -Mes, -Fecha, -Hora, -c(16,18:22))
```

```{r}
diamult <- floor(nrow(df_clima_2026)/49)
xmult <- 0:diamult
xfiles <- xmult*49+1

df_weather_2026 <- df_clima_2026 %>% 
  slice(-xfiles) %>% 
  mutate(
    DateTime = as.POSIXct(paste(Fecha, format(Hora, "%H:%M:%S")), format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
    Semana = isoweek(Fecha)) %>%
  select(-c(1,2, 8:11, 13, 14, 16, 17, 18, 22, 23, 25:31, 33, 34, 36:41))
```

```{r}
names(df_weather_2025) <- c("Semana", "t_ext", "t_max", "t_min", "humid", "dewpt", "v_max", "rain", "solar", "uv", "evotransp", "DateTime")

names(df_weather_2026) <- c("t_ext", "t_max", "t_min", "humid", "dewpt", "v_max", "heat_idx", "rain", "rain_i", "solar", "uv", "heat", "evotransp", "DateTime", "Semana")
```

```{r}
df_weather_hist <- df_weather_2025 %>% 
  bind_rows(df_weather_2026)
```

```{r}
df_weather_hist <- df_weather_hist %>% 
  arrange(DateTime) %>% 
  mutate(
    gdd = (t_ext-10)*as.numeric(difftime(DateTime,lag(DateTime),units="days")),
    v_max_ms = v_max/3.6
  )
```

```{r}
names(df_weather_hist) <- c("Semana", "Temp. Exterior  (C°)", "Temp. Maxima (C°)", "Temp. Minima (C°)", "Humedad Externa (%)", "Punto Rocio (C°)", "Velocida Max (km/hr)", "Lluvia (mm)", "Radiacion Solar (w/m2)", "Indice Rayos UV F7", "Evapotranspiracion (mm)", "FechaHora", "Indice de Calor", "Intensidad de Lluvia (mm/hr)", "Calor", "Grados Día", "Velocidad Max (m/s)")
```

```{r}
write_xlsx(df_weather_hist, "G:/Unidades compartidas/Compartido Proyecciones/11.- Variables Meteorológicas/2026/5.- Actualización Diaria/Meteorologia_Historica.xlsx")
```
